name: es31-atomics
title: Atomic counters and atomic memory functions
summary: Atomic counters (layout binding/offset incl. inherited offsets and arrays, increment/decrement/read, wrap-around, glBufferSubData initialisation, glBindBufferRange, ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER program interface queries) and atomicAdd/Min/Max/And/Or/Xor/Exchange/CompSwap on buffer and shared variables under heavy contention (65536 invocations on the same words) with exactly known final values, set-property checks for the order-dependent operations, two stream compactions validated as sets, fragment-stage atomic counters, and displays drawn by shaders that read the atomic results.
spec: ES 3.2 §7.7 Atomic Counter Buffers (§7.7.1 Atomic Counter Buffer Object Storage, §7.7.2 Atomic Counter Buffer Bindings)
ES 3.2 §7.8 Shader Buffer Variables and Shader Storage Blocks
ES 3.2 §7.3.1 Program Interfaces (ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER and UNIFORM interfaces, Table 7.2), §7.3.1.1 Naming Active Resources
ES 3.2 §6.1.1 Binding Buffer Objects to Indexed Targets, §6.6.1 Indexed Buffer Object Limits and Binding Queries (Table 6.5)
ES 3.2 §7.11.1 Shader Memory Access Ordering, §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization, §11.1.3.6 Atomic Counter Access
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.1.7.3 Atomic Counters, §4.1.8 Structures, §4.4.5 Opaque Uniform Layout Qualifiers, §4.4.6 Atomic Counter Layout Qualifiers
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.3.8 Shared Variables, §8.10 Atomic-Counter Functions, §8.11 Atomic Memory Functions, §8.14 Shader Invocation Control Functions

api.glDispatchCompute: counters, memory atomics, compaction and scatter shaders: 512 groups of 128 invocations on the same words; all results compared with exact CPU values or set properties
api.glBindBufferBase: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER binding 0 (counters of the heavy run, compaction pointer, fragment counters) and SSBO bindings 0-2; indexed BINDING/START/SIZE read back; index >= MAX_ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_BINDINGS -> INVALID_VALUE; buffer 0 unbinds
api.glBindBufferRange: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER range (offset 16, size 32) in a 64-byte buffer: counters are exact and the canary words around the range are untouched; START 16 / SIZE 32 read back; offset 2, size 0, index >= MAX -> INVALID_VALUE and the binding is unchanged
api.glBufferData: atomic counter buffers, accumulator, input, output and mask buffers (observed through the exact results)
api.glBufferSubData: every counter is initialised at its offset (5000, 1000, 1000000, 0xFFFFFFF0, ...): the final values are exact functions of those initial values; the compaction pointer is reset with it
api.glMapBufferRange: MAP_READ of ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER and SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER data after the dispatches
api.glUnmapBuffer: returns TRUE for every read mapping
api.glBindBuffer: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER / SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER general bindings for uploads, sub-updates and mappings
api.glGetIntegeri_v: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_BINDING of bound and out-of-range indices (INVALID_VALUE); MAX_COMPUTE_WORK_GROUP_SIZE/COUNT[0] against the ES 3.1 minimums
api.glGetInteger64i_v: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_START and ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_SIZE after glBindBufferBase/Range; out-of-range index -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetIntegerv: MAX_ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_BINDINGS/SIZE, MAX_{COMPUTE,FRAGMENT,VERTEX,COMBINED}_ATOMIC_COUNTER(_BUFFERS), MAX_COMPUTE_WORK_GROUP_INVOCATIONS against the spec minimums; the general ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_BINDING equals the bound buffer
api.glGetProgramResourceIndex: the seven counter uniforms are found by name ("c_hist[0]" for the array)
api.glGetProgramResourceiv: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER: BUFFER_BINDING 0, BUFFER_DATA_SIZE >= 32, NUM_ACTIVE_VARIABLES 7, ACTIVE_VARIABLES, REFERENCED_BY_COMPUTE/FRAGMENT_SHADER; UNIFORM: ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_INDEX, OFFSET (incl. the inherited 20), ARRAY_SIZE, ARRAY_STRIDE 4, TYPE, BLOCK_INDEX -1, LOCATION -1
api.glGetActiveUniform: c_odd is reported with type UNSIGNED_INT_ATOMIC_COUNTER
api.glGetUniformLocation: an atomic counter has location -1; the ordinary uniforms (u_n, u_phase, ...) are active
api.glUseProgram: counters, memory, racy, two compaction, scatter, strip, histogram and panel programs
api.glUniform1ui: u_n, u_phase, u_ticket0, u_dec0, u_wrap0, u_count: the results are exact functions of these values
api.glUniform1f: u_scale / u_y0 (histogram bar height) and u_x0 (panel origin): probed in the framebuffer
api.glDrawArrays: fullscreen triangle for the strip, the histogram and the two panels: the fragment shaders read SSBOs written by atomics; 16 cells, 16 bars and 2 x 16384 pixels probed; fragment counters count exactly 16384 fragments
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT; areas above the bars keep the clear colour
api.glClearColor: background pixels equal the clear colour
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of strip cells, bars and both panels
api.glCompileShader: layout-rule experiments: a counter at binding MAX_ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_BINDINGS, an offset without binding and an atomic_uint in a structure are rejected; all shaders of the demo compile
api.glLinkProgram: overlapping counter offsets are rejected; min(MAX_COMPUTE_ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFERS, MAX_ATOMIC_COUNTER_BUFFER_BINDINGS) bindings link

visual_review.notes: Viewed gpu es-max (build/debug/test-results/es31-atomics_gpu_es-max.png, 256x256) and zink es-max (identical). Top 16-px strip: 12 green cells with dark separators, 4 dark unused cells. Middle: a 16-bar histogram falling off from a tall blue bar (bin 0, 100 px) to a bar about 1 px high, colours fading blue to orange, no gaps in the tallest bars except the 1-px separators. Bottom: two identical 128x128 panels of concentric yellow/dark rings (a lit disc in the centre, rings thinning outwards) - the compacted ring pattern from the atomic-counter append (left) and the SSBO atomicAdd append (right); no stray pixels or seams between the panels.
